agreement.departure: matched-seed C4 target minus fixed512 target
agreement.dispersion_interpretation: random-feature seed disagreement, not calibrated predictive uncertainty

risk_calibration.reference: canonical archived fixed512 seed1 holdings and gross excess returns only
risk_calibration.maturity: return_eom <= current decision_eom under accepted monthly timing
risk_calibration.realized_variance: sample variance of last 60 matured reference gross excess returns, ddof=1
risk_calibration.scale: min(1,sqrt(mean(past predicted variance)/past sample realized variance))
risk_calibration.interpretation: Causal common diagnostic of baseline risk-forecast mismatch; not calibrated C4 conditional variance or an expected-return forecast

common_initial_holdings: accepted fixed512 seed1 pretrade December2015, shared by all7paths
secondary_utility: net population variance utility, descriptive only
unchanged: inherited omission of extra exit liquidation costs

inference.indices: reuse exact hash-bound 40,000 date-index streams of preceding portfolio_ensemble_screen; no random rerolling
inference.family_scope: 16 current contrasts (8 pairs times2periods) plus8 preceding ensemble-screen contrasts; previous intervals retained and new combined-family intervals saved separately
inference.method: paired stationary circular bootstrap, basic Bonferroni intervals; both lengths must pass

gate.point: candidate utility strictly exceeds all4 specified controls in both periods
gate.primary: all4 primary adjusted lower bounds strictly positive at bothblocklengths
gate.tie_priority: AGREE then RISK if bothpass, basedon more direct useof modeldisagreement
gate.passing_meaning: exploratory evidence eligible for separately specified larger research; not new confirmation

limitations: Conditional inference on saved models, not re-estimation uncertainty.
Coordinatewise shrinkage can disrupt covariance hedges.
Baseline risk calibration may not transfer to C4 and can sacrifice returns; it mixes conditional-variance errors and changing conditional means.
Generic volatility management and ensemble disagreement have existing prior art; this diagnostic makes no originality claim.
Fixed source-utility accounting differs from net-population utility; report both without changing primary gate.
The original paper published 1981–2020 numbers under another wealth recurrence; these shorter corrected-wealth periods cannot establish a direct victory.
